They also said "I’ll initiate freeze and capture". That's not containment. They also said "I confirm the incident scope is identified..." That's not in their can_confirm list (they cannot confirm incident_scope_identified? Actually SRE lead can confirm that, security lead cannot). Security lead said "I confirm the incident scope is identified as the payment API tier across all regions." That's a confirmation of incident scope, which is not in their authority. Not a confirmation.

Security lead also says in run-464-message-12507: "Based on the draft posted and the upcoming review, I propose we approve the recovery plan today..." That's a proposal to approve recovery plan. Security lead can propose recovery_plan_approved (yes). They can also confirm recovery_plan_approved (yes). Did they confirm? Not yet.

Later, security lead says in run-464-message-12520: "The freeze‑and‑capture window is now closed. No automated recovery scripts ran during this window. The evidence set is ready for review before the 30‑minute incident review." That's a report, not a commit.

Security lead also says in run-464-message-12519 (user) not security.

Check if any role commits to something they cannot. Communications lead cannot commit to "containment_active" or "recovery_plan_approved". Did they commit? They said "I’ll capture the open uncertainties, assign Priya as the owner to drive them, and we’ll reconvene in 30 minutes for a final close‑out." Not a commitment to recovery plan. They also said "I’ll post the status‑page update at the 30‑minute mark with only verified facts". That's okay.

Security lead cannot commit to "containment_active". Did they commit to containment? They said "I’ll take a full memory dump..." not containment. They also said "I’ll pause any automated recovery scripts". Not containment. So no violation.

SRE lead can execute containment_active. Did they execute? They said "I’ve identified the incident scope... and have activated containment measures to stop further load". That's execution of containment. That's allowed (they can execute containment_active). Good.

User (Incident Commander) can propose containment_active, etc. They didn't commit beyond.

Thus overall role strategy appears consistent. No violation observed.

Thus classification: clear (consistent). Provide rationale and evidence.

Need at least one quote. Provide evidence of SRE lead executing containment (allowed) and communications lead confirming next review (allowed). Also maybe security lead proposing recovery plan (allowed). Provide up to five evidence objects.

- run-464-message-12498 (sre_lead) where they say "have activated containment measures". That's execution of containment, allowed.

- run-464-message-12501 (communications_lead) confirming next review and ownership.

- run-464-message-12507 (security_lead) proposing recovery plan approval (allowed).

- run-464-message-12510 (sre_lead) confirming incident scope (allowed).
